images.caption: A view from the Oostvaardersdijk (Oostvaarder Dyke), which runs from Lelystad to the west-south-west. The dyke separates the Flevolands polders (including the Oostvaardersplassen nature reserve; left)  from the IJsselmeer (right). One can see in this photo that the polder is actually lower than the sea level (the IJsselmeer)!
images.alt: A view from the Oostvaardersdijk (Oostvaarder Dyke), which runs from Lelystad to the west-south-west. The dyke separates the Flevolands polders (including the Oostvaardersplassen nature reserve; left)  from the IJsselmeer (right). One can see in this photo that the polder is actually lower than the sea level (the IJsselmeer)!
